Image 2 and 3 are composition and pixel-art style references ONLY, not text or character identity.
Create one square polished pixel-art meme illustration filling the entire canvas, no rounded UI card, no watermark, no terminal title bar. Like the references: big chunky high-contrast pixel lettering at top, large expressive screen-shaped character in the bottom two thirds, a humorous dev desk scene, crisp pixel edges.
